qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the cross member to body mounting?
What torque should be applied to the rubber mounts to cross member or transmission?
What is the torque specification for the support tube to engine subframe on E36 models?
What torque value is specified for the rubber mounts to carrier pipe on E36 models?
What is the carrier plate torque specification for E36 models?
Which transmission mount component has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The support tube to engine subframe at 42 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which vehicle type applies to the cross member to body mounting specification?
Are the rubber mount specifications the same for all mounting locations?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the support tube to engine subframe requires 42 Nm while other rubber mounts require 21 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which components in this table are specific to E36 models only?
qa_pairs.answer: Support tube to engine subframe, rubber mounts to carrier pipe, and carrier plate
